first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1306502 (Bridge Inn, Topsham, Exeter), returned from the official Listed Building polygons layer with bound ListEntry/Name/Grade attributes. The official layer schema confirms polygon geometry and the NHLE record supplies explicit Inn type/use evidence and a 7 June 2022 amendment, but the exact single-record GeoJSON payload was not retrievable through the available web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature geometry could be read; no geometry was inferred or fabricated.
